title: ArchGen Task
description: Contract for a single task entry in an .archgen/<slug>/tasks.yaml file. NORMATIVE GRAPH SEMANTICS: depends_on lists PREREQUISITE task ids (never dependents). A task is ready iff all prerequisites are done; otherwise it is blocked. Wave 1 consists exactly of tasks whose depends_on is empty. Example: A{depends_on:[B]}, B{depends_on:[C]}, C{depends_on:[]} resolves to waves [[C],[B],[A]]. depends_on graphs MUST be acyclic.

id.description: Unique stable task identifier within the tasks file. Referenced by other tasks' depends_on entries.

title.description: Human-readable one-line summary of the task.

status.description: Lifecycle state. Canonical enum is EXACTLY these six values - 'cancelled' does not exist in this contract.

depends_on.description: Prerequisite task ids that must reach status 'done' before this task can run. Empty array = wave-1 task. Must not contain dangling references or cycles.

parallel_group.description: Optional label grouping tasks intended to execute concurrently within the same wave. Tasks sharing a parallel_group MUST have disjoint file_ownership.

file_ownership.description: Glob paths this task exclusively owns while running. REQUIRED and non-empty: two tasks scheduled in the same wave must never overlap on any owned path.

artifacts.description: Paths of files this task produces or meaningfully modifies (outputs, reports, generated code).

acceptance.description: Checkable acceptance criteria; every entry must be verifiable before the task may be marked done.
